Maneuvering

Plano de Compensação de Força Lateral

A navigational strategy to counteract lateral forces (wind, current, propeller wash) that may cause a vessel to drift sideways during berthing or channel transit.

Quick answer: A navigational strategy to counteract lateral forces (wind, current, propeller wash) that may cause a vessel to drift sideways during berthing or channel transit.

Questions and answers

What is Plano de Compensação de Força Lateral?

In this glossary, Plano de Compensação de Força Lateral refers to: A navigational strategy to counteract lateral forces (wind, current, propeller wash) that may cause a vessel to drift sideways during berthing or channel transit.

How is Plano de Compensação de Força Lateral used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Prático para ponte: Ative o plano de compensação de força lateral para manter a linha central durante o trânsito em condições de vento lateral."

Definition

A navigational strategy to counteract lateral forces (wind, current, propeller wash) that may cause a vessel to drift sideways during berthing or channel transit.

Operational example

Pilot to bridge: Activate sideforce compensation plan to maintain centerline during transit in crosswind conditions.

Localized term

Plano de Compensação de Força Lateral

Localized example

Prático para ponte: Ative o plano de compensação de força lateral para manter a linha central durante o trânsito em condições de vento lateral.
